This directory contains snapshots of three additional projects to support Java and Windows:
- [JSAP - Java Simple Argument Parser](https://martiansoftware.com/jsap/)
- [Remote Tea - Java-based ONC/RPC implementation](https://sourceforge.net/projects/remotetea/)
- [oncrpc_win32 - Windows port of ONC/RPC library](https://sourceforge.net/projects/oncrpc-windows/)

Please consult each subdirectory for its licensing information.
